description: Complete the P2P Mycelium layer: connect IrohDocsReplicator to real iroh-docs Engine, implement petal-level replication, real-time transform sync, gossip topics, and tileset P2P

phases.name: IrohDocsReplicator Integration
phases.description: Connect IrohDocsReplicator to real iroh_docs::Engine instead of in-memory HashMap

phases.name: Petal-Level Replication
phases.description: Full SubscribePetal/UnsubscribePetal implementation with per-petal namespaces

phases.name: Real-Time Transform Sync
phases.description: Broadcast node transform changes to peers via iroh-gossip

phases.name: Gossip Topic Subscription
phases.description: Subscribe to iroh-gossip topics per Verse and per Petal

phases.name: Tileset P2P
phases.description: Implement tileset advertisement, metadata request, and chunk fetch over P2P
